html:
The Garingbal, or Karingbal, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Carnarvon Range country in central Queensland. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Their speech was one of several once counted as dialects of the Biri language, though recent research suggests some of these were separate languages. They are among the traditional owners of the Carnarvon Gorge area, with its rock art, which they share with the Bidjara. Other neighbours on the map include the Wadjigu and the Gungabula. Squatters reached the region in the 1850s and 1860s. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
